academic.text: Normally applicants are expected to have at least a lower second-class Bachelor’s degree from a UK university, or an overseas qualification of an equivalent standard, usually in mathematics or in education. Professional experience of teaching or tutoring will also be considered as relevant experience. In addition, applicants should demonstrate commitment and a clearly expressed interest in issues relating to mathematics education, through the submission of an additional specific maths education written task.

china_requirement.quote:
Lower second-class (2:2)
Bachelor's degree with a minimum weighted average mark of 80% from an institution reviewed by UCL.
Or
A Bachelor's degree with a minimum weighted average mark of 85% is required from all other universities recognised by the Chinese Ministry of Education.

ielts.quote: Level 2: Overall score of 7.0 and a minimum of 6.5 in each component

toefl.quote: Level 2: Overall score of 76 with a minimum of 70 in reading, writing, listening and speaking
